headline: Sarvam releases open-weight Sarvam-105B-1711 checkpoint
quote: its average across eight conversational agent benchmarks rose from 42.6 to 73.9
claim: Sarvam released Sarvam-105B-1711, a new open-weight checkpoint of Sarvam 105B trained on B200 infrastructure; its average across eight conversational agent benchmarks rose from 42.6 to 73.9 versus the February release, and blended price fell by two-thirds from $0.44.
why_it_matters: A stronger Indic-capable open-weight model you can self-host or call cheaply for voice and support agents.
title: Sarvam-105B-1711: a new Sarvam 105B checkpoint | Sarvam AI

headline: Sarvam launches Token Factory inference platform in India
quote: Token Factory is our inference stack to serve our own models and leading open-weight models from GPU clusters located in India.
claim: Sarvam launched Token Factory on 16 Nov 2026, an inference stack serving its own and leading open-weight models from GPU clusters located in India.
why_it_matters: An India-hosted API for open models gives builders lower latency and data-residency options.
title: Introducing Sarvam Token Factory | Sarvam AI

headline: Sarvam says Token Factory uses no subsidised GPUs amid Chinese-model row
quote: The company said its subsidised access under the IndiaAI Mission, used to train its own models, ended in March 2026.
claim: After criticism over hosting Chinese models on Token Factory, Sarvam said the platform runs on privately procured GPUs and that its IndiaAI Mission subsidised access ended in March 2026.
why_it_matters: Shows the sovereignty debate over who gets public compute and what startups may sell on top of open models.
title: Explained: Sarvam AI's Token Factory and debate over AI sovereignty goals | Artificial Intelligence News - Business Standard

headline: Soket AI raises $4 Mn from Bajaj Finserv and Pennant
quote: Soket AI has raised $4 Mn (around ₹37 Cr) from Bajaj Finserv's applied research and innovation initiative Finserv Intelligence, and Pennant Technologies
claim: Soket AI, maker of the IndiaAI-backed EKA-1 model, raised $4 Mn (around ₹37 Cr) from Bajaj Finserv's Finserv Intelligence and Pennant Technologies.
why_it_matters: Funding for an Indian sovereign-model lab signals where model-building jobs and enterprise demand may grow.
title: Soket AI Raises $4 Mn From Bajaj Finserv To Expand Its AI Model Horizon

headline: CtrlS targets 4.4 GW data centre capacity by 2030
quote: CtrlS Datacentres is targeting 4.4 GW of capacity by 2030, with investments spanning established technology hubs and smaller cities
claim: CtrlS is targeting 4.4 GW of capacity by 2030 and recently announced a ₹10,000 crore, 150 MW AI factory in Bodh Gaya, Bihar, plus a ₹400 crore, 12 MW Patna data centre.
why_it_matters: More domestic GPU and cloud capacity in tier-2 cities could lower compute costs for Indian builders.
title: Inside CtrlS’s 4.4 GW Bet on India’s Data Centre Boom
